foot: Made by RJ’s TNT Tools. TNT Tools’ own work, not a Heavy Iron product. 37 proof items and 46 benchmark entries are held until a decision on a paper: they are counted here and not shown.

graph.lede: Every requirement, use case step, decision, break and test the loop holds about its own code is one entity in this graph; the bars count them by kind. The graph growing means the record grew, not that the code improved.

lede: The closed loop's running stats, read from the files it keeps about itself. Every value names the file it came from, or says UNKNOWN and why. Every run measured here was small, and nothing on this page speaks to large systems.

auto_switch.text: built; its results are not shown on this page.

parts.lede: Each optional part has a state, and a reason the registry gives for it. The mode is one setting for all of them: with token saving on, a part that spends model tokens starts off until its threshold is tuned. A meter shows a part's wake stat against its threshold; a stat with no threshold set yet is UNKNOWN. A pass run with a flag can differ from the registry, and its report says what it ran.

mode.meaning: every part starts on, and the GNN waits for its stat.

passes.lede: One row per pass of the loop on a project, as the loop wrote it. A chart draws a line only through three or more readings, and breaks it where a pass holds no reading; with fewer it shows the readings as dots.

passes.trend_note: Each verdict is loop_stats.Trend's, read against the direction the stat should move. Under three passes it says too few. A rise in the share caught does not show the tests got better.

proof.lede: The last time every command in the benchmark record was run again, and the state each entry records. Pass, fail, unknown (it gave no answer or may have checked nothing) and not run are different things, and the board counts them apart.
